title: Shift compatibility of the specified refinement-restriction transformation
statement:
∀ (θ : ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ push R r.hom) ⋙ pull R d.i ⟶
        (openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ pull R c.i),
      (∀ M, θ.app M = refinementRestriction R r hi M) → θ.CommShift ℤ

proof.text: The exact open pullback compositor, proper adjunction counit, and their canonical derived shift structures commute with integer shifts. The component formula is their composite, and naturality identifies any transformation with those components; therefore its shift square is the canonical one.
